decision: SEASONAL LICENSED SOURCE DISCOVERY #1 BLOCKED — NO QUALIFYING LICENSED SOURCE

sourceEvidence.title: Missouri catalog
sourceEvidence.finding: No license URL in the reviewed catalog; public access and update metadata are not a reuse grant.

sourceEvidence.title: NYC official dataset metadata
sourceEvidence.finding: Direct D02: official provenance, DPR attribution, 16 columns, daily update schedule; no licenseId/license supplied.

sourceEvidence.title: NYC robots
sourceEvidence.finding: Direct D03: wildcard crawl delay 1 second; reviewed rules do not disallow tested resource path. Not a reuse grant.

sourceEvidence.title: NYC Public Policies
sourceEvidence.finding: Affirmative public-dataset use framework; attribution/version/modification disclosure may be required; portal can rate-limit.

sourceEvidence.title: NYC published Local Law 11 of 2012
sourceEvidence.finding: Sections 23-502(b),(d), 23-505 address automated formats, use and modification disclosure, and APIs. Historical city-published law text; not a full current codification opinion.

sourceEvidence.title: NYC portal terms
sourceEvidence.finding: Direct D05: portal incorporates NYC general/provider terms, disclaimers and source version control. Inert JSON story text reviewed; no scripts run.

sourceEvidence.title: Socrata application tokens
sourceEvidence.finding: Simple unauthenticated queries documented; anonymous shared IP throttling; numerical anonymous quota not given; 429 indicates throttling. Documentation copyright license is not the data license.

sourceEvidence.title: NYC general terms
sourceEvidence.finding: Protects city and third-party IP, prohibits disruption. Public-fact scope must be distinguished from expressive content.

sourceEvidence.title: NYC Public Standards
sourceEvidence.finding: API section explicitly documents SODA access to published datasets; structured downloads supported.

sourceEvidence.title: NPS getting started
sourceEvidence.finding: Official invitation to use API data in applications/maps/websites; free key registration required.

sourceEvidence.title: NPS API guides
sourceEvidence.finding: Key authentication; default hourly limit 1000; terms link to Disclaimer. No key obtained or used.

sourceEvidence.title: NPS Disclaimer
sourceEvidence.finding: Qualified public-domain policy for NPS-created works; commercial publication notice; third-party content and marks excluded.

sourceEvidence.title: NPS interactive reference
sourceEvidence.finding: Text retrieval exposed no usable event schema or sample; not substituted with third-party wrapper schema.

sourceEvidence.title: USDA catalog
sourceEvidence.finding: Explicit CC0 assignment for usda-ams-2015-N039; legacy HTTP Excel export; modified 2015-10-19.

sourceEvidence.title: CC0 deed
sourceEvidence.finding: Describes commercial reuse, modification and distribution without permission; other rights and non-endorsement remain.

sourceEvidence.title: USDA current directory documentation
sourceEvidence.finding: Official directory description and API-forthcoming statement; no current export schema or occurrence sample reviewed.

sourceEvidence.title: Art Institute API documentation
sourceEvidence.finding: Events/occurrences carry restricted-use notices, not collection CC0; anonymous field-selecting access documented. Exact section headings: Events, Event Occurrences, Authentication, Scraping Data.

sourceEvidence.title: Art Institute terms
sourceEvidence.finding: Reference fetch returned 403 Forbidden; no follow-up or alternate-route bypass.
